spans.text: Idhānanda, dāyako ca hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo, paṭiggāhakā ca honti dussīlā pāpadhammā— It’s when both the giver and the recipient are unethical, of bad character.
Idhānanda, dāyako ca hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, paṭiggāhakā ca honti sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā— It’s when both the giver and the recipient are ethical, of good character.

entries.description: These are the four ways of purifying a religious donation
entries.subject: These
entries.object: the four ways of purifying a religious donation

spans.text: Imā kho, ānanda, catasso dakkhiṇā visuddhiyo”ti. These are the four ways of purifying a religious donation.”

Yo dussīlo dussīlesu dadāti dānaṁ, When an unethical and untrusting person, Adhammena laddhaṁ appasannacitto; gives an improper gift to unethical persons, Anabhisaddahaṁ kammaphalaṁ uḷāraṁ, not trusting in the ample fruit of deeds, Na taṁ dānaṁ vipulapphalanti brūmi.

Yo dussīlo sīlavantesu dadāti dānaṁ, When an unethical and untrusting person, Adhammena laddhaṁ appasannacitto; gives an improper gift to ethical persons, Anabhisaddahaṁ kammaphalaṁ uḷāraṁ, not trusting in the ample fruit of deeds, Tassuddānaṁ Bhaddekānandakaccāna, Lomasakaṅgiyāsubho; Mahākammasaḷāyatanavibhaṅgā, Uddesaaraṇā dhātu saccaṁ.

Yo dussīlo dussīlesu dadāti dānaṁ, When an unethical and untrusting person, Adhammena laddhaṁ appasannacitto; gives an improper gift to unethical persons, Anabhisaddahaṁ kammaphalaṁ uḷāraṁ, not trusting in the ample fruit of deeds, Na taṁ dānaṁ vipulapphalanti brūmi.

Yo sīlavā sīlavantesu dadāti dānaṁ, When an ethical person with trusting heart Dhammena laddhaṁ supasannacitto; gives a proper gift to ethical persons, Abhisaddahaṁ kammaphalaṁ uḷāraṁ, trusting in the ample fruit of deeds, Taṁ ve dānaṁ vipulapphalanti brūmi.

Yo vītarāgo vītarāgesu dadāti dānaṁ, But when a passionless one gives to the passionless Idaṁ vatvāna sugato athāparaṁ etadavoca satthā: Then the Holy One, the Teacher, went on to say: Dhammena laddhaṁ supasannacitto; a proper gift with trusting heart, Abhisaddahaṁ kammaphalaṁ uḷāraṁ, trusting in the ample fruit of deeds, Taṁ ve dānaṁ āmisadānānamaggan”ti. that’s truly the best of material gifts.”

“Yo sīlavā dussīlesu dadāti dānaṁ, “When an ethical person with trusting heart Dhammena laddhaṁ supasannacitto; gives a proper gift to unethical persons, Abhisaddahaṁ kammaphalaṁ uḷāraṁ, trusting in the ample fruit of deeds, Sā dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati.

entries.description: Atha kho mahāpajāpati gotamī navaṁ dussayugaṁ ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami
entries.subject: Atha
entries.object: mahāpajāpati gotamī navaṁ dussayugaṁ ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami

spans.text: Atha kho mahāpajāpati gotamī navaṁ dussayugaṁ ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi.
She bowed, sat down to one side, and said to the Buddha, Dutiyampi kho bhagavā mahāpajāpatiṁ gotamiṁ etadavoca: “saṅghe, gotami, dehi.

entries.description: Mahāpajāpati Gotamī said to the Buddha
entries.subject: Mahāpajāpati Gotamī

spans.text: Saṅghe te dinne ahañceva pūjito bhavissāmi saṅgho cā”ti. Tatiyampi kho mahāpajāpati gotamī bhagavantaṁ etadavoca: For a third time, Mahāpajāpati Gotamī said to the Buddha, “idaṁ me, bhante, navaṁ dussayugaṁ bhagavantaṁ uddissa sāmaṁ kantaṁ sāmaṁ vāyitaṁ.
Tatiyampi kho bhagavā mahāpajāpatiṁ gotamiṁ etadavoca: And for a third time, the Buddha said to her, “saṅghe, gotami, dehi.
Evaṁ vutte, bhagavā mahāpajāpatiṁ gotamiṁ etadavoca: When she said this, the Buddha said to her, “saṅghe, gotami, dehi.
Evaṁ vutte, bhagavā mahāpajāpatiṁ gotamiṁ etadavoca: When she said this, the Buddha said to her, “saṅghe, gotami, dehi.

Taṁ me, bhante, bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṁ upādāyā”ti. Evaṁ vutte, āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṁ etadavoca: When he said this, Venerable Ānanda said to the Buddha, Bhagavāpi, bhante, bahūpakāro mahāpajāpatiyā gotamiyā”ti. The Buddha has been very helpful to Mahāpajāpati.”
